recordings.remarks: Alarm call made during middle of day when there were a couple Rainbow Lorikeets quite close to where the Frogmouth was roosting which appeared to irritate it. Frogmouths have been in the garden for several years and have only heard this call occasionally, however, this bird appears to be quite irritable and I’ve heard this alarm call most days recently. Recorded on iPhone.
